cases.name: composite-action-review
cases.prompt:
Review this composite action and return a corrected action.yml.

name: notify
inputs:
  title:
    required: true
  channel:
    default: general
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: some-org/setup-notifier@main
    - run: echo "Posting ${{ inputs.title }} to ${{ inputs.channel }}"
    - run: ./scripts/post.sh "${{ inputs.title }}" ${{ inputs.channel }}
      shell: bash

It is called from pull_request workflows where title is the PR title.
cases.trap: Fixing only the missing shell, or quoting the ${{ }} expressions, which still splices attacker-controlled text into shell source; relative script path resolves against the caller's cwd.
expectations: Moves inputs into env: (e.g. TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}) and references them as quoted shell variables instead of interpolating ${{ inputs.* }} into run
Adds shell: to the run step that lacks it
Resolves the script via $GITHUB_ACTION_PATH (or github.action_path) rather than ./scripts relative to the caller workspace
Pins some-org/setup-notifier to a full commit SHA instead of @main
negative_expectations: Leaves ${{ inputs.title }} inside any run: script body, even if wrapped in quotes
Claims the composite action isolates or sandboxes the caller's token or environment
